title: RAG index bootstrap and self-heal
repo_context: Ensure RAG index artifacts are initialized after embeddings install and can self-repair without auto-indexing user docs.

stories.title: Add idempotent backend bootstrap helper in retrieval
acceptance_criteria: A backend helper in retrieval/semantic index maintenance ensures empty manifest, hnsw, and metadata db artifacts exist for a pool and returns a stable report.
Calling the helper twice with the same pool is non-destructive and returns a status indicating already initialized.
If embeddings are missing/unloadable, the helper returns a stable "embeddings missing" reason without mutation.
If artifacts are partially missing or the manifest identity mismatches runtime identity, the helper returns a "needs force repair" reason without mutation unless `force=true`.
A new test alongside the retrieval maintenance module verifies creation of missing artifacts and idempotent behavior.
stories.notes: Keep diagnose read-only; helper should not index documents or create artifacts when embeddings are missing.

stories.title: Add POST /api/index/bootstrap endpoint
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/index/bootstrap accepts optional pool_identifier and force, and bootstraps both pools when omitted.
Endpoint is added to the existing index maintenance router (`backend/api/endpoints/index_maintenance.py`).
Response includes per-pool bootstrapped status and current pool_open report, including embeddings-missing and needs-force reasons.
API tests cover bootstrap for a single pool and for both pools in `backend/api/test_index_maintenance.py`.
stories.notes: Endpoint must not index user docs; keep diagnose read-only.

stories.title: Self-repair in /api/index/execute when artifacts missing
acceptance_criteria: When /api/index/execute encounters missing index artifacts, it calls the bootstrap helper and retries pool open before running the job.
If bootstrap fails, execute returns a clear reason without crashing.
API test covers missing-artifact scenario and confirms execute proceeds after bootstrap.
stories.notes: Call helper directly; keep behavior non-destructive unless explicitly forced.

stories.title: Trigger bootstrap after embeddings install
acceptance_criteria: Assets tray calls POST /api/index/bootstrap when embedding asset transitions to installed.
The call is guarded to avoid repeated bootstrap calls during normal polling.
stories.notes: No auto-indexing; only initialize empty artifacts.

stories.title: Auto-bootstrap on RAG panel open when missing files
acceptance_criteria: If diagnose reports pool_open missing files, the RAG index panel triggers a one-time bootstrap and re-runs diagnose.
stories.notes: Only run when embeddings are installed.

stories.title: Update RAG health messaging for not-initialized state
acceptance_criteria: When embeddings are installed but index artifacts are missing or empty, UI shows Not Indexed Yet and offers Initialize action.
When embeddings are not installed, UI shows Embedding model not installed with install CTA.
stories.notes: Avoid labeling this state as UNAVAILABLE.
